
Metabolic pathways inferred from the Prokka annotations with MinPath. Commands for this step were run in `minpath/`.

Change into the `minpath` folder:

```{bash}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/minpath
```

Inputs for minpath will be prepared for each bin based on the prokka `.tsv` file. Start by looking at the `.tsv` file for a single bin

```{bash}
head ../prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv
```

Just wanna try another one

```{bash}
head ../prokka/metabat.7/metabat.7.tsv
```

It works

For input to minpath we only want to keep a unique ID for each gene (column 1) and its EC number (column 5). We can transform the tsv into this format using awk like this

```{bash}
head ../prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv | awk -F '\t' '{print $1,$5}'
```

here we are using `-F '\t'` to tell awk that our input is tab separated. We also want to filter the output to only include lines with an EC number

```{bash}
head ../prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{print $1,$5}'
```

 need to ensure that the output is tab separated and we also need to remove the header line

```{bash}
head ../prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'
```

This of course only processes the first 10 lines … we need to change `head` to `cat` to include all genes

```{bash}
cat ../prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'
```

create the .ec file

```{bash}
cat ../prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus' > metabat.66.ec
```

run minpath on this file

```{bash}
minpath -ec metabat.66.ec -report metabat.66.ec.report -details metabat.66.ec.details
```

look at the top few lines

```{bash}
head metabat.66.ec.report 
```

note: explanation of the line

Important parts of this line are

- **PWY-7321** which is a pathway identifier in the metacyc database. You can use this to lookup the full pathway. Eg [PWY-7321](https://biocyc.org/META/NEW-IMAGE?type=PATHWAY&object=PWY-7321)

- **naive 1** tells us that at least one gene from this pathway was found. Simply calling a pathway present whenever one of its genes is found is the “naive” approach

- **minpath 1** tells us that minpath kept this pathway in its minimal set of pathways. If this says `minpath 0` then minpath decided that the genes found are better explained by other pathways, so the evidence for this one is weak

- **fam0 4** tells us that four gene families are involved in this pathway

- **fam-found 2** tells us that we found 2 gene families from the pathway in this genome

- **name ecdysteroid metabolism (arthropods)** is a name for the pathway

**Prokka**

since prokka is done i can now prepare a minipath for all bins

```{bash}
while read bin;do 
  cat ../prokka/$bin/${bin}.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{printf("%s\t%s\n", $1,$5)}' | grep -v '^locus' > ${bin}.ec 
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

run minpath on every bin.

```{bash}
while read bin;do 
  minpath -ec ${bin}.ec -report ${bin}.ec.report -details ${bin}.ec.details
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

- didnt take to long

i will only look at two of the pathways.

```{bash}
grep 'PWY-101' *.ec.report
```

This pathway includes the essential components of photosynthesis that occur in light, Photosystem I and Photosystem II.

- i got 4 lines and all are photosynthesis light reactions

**Question 4.1**

- How many bins contain at least one gene from this pathway?

there are 4 bins that contain atlest one pathway from this pathway.

- Which bin has all of the genes (ie a complete pathway)?

there is one bin the metabat.66 with fam-found 4, and the fam0 is 4, which means metabat.66 is the onlyone with all of the genes.

- For which bins does minpath keep the pathway (`minpath 1`)?

minpath 1 is only kept on two of the bins the metabat.66 and metabat.7

**Question 4.2**

- How many bins contain the pathway PWY-5360?

there is only one bin that has this pathway.

- What order (in a taxonomic sense) do these bins belong to? Are they in the same family?

this bin belonge to the order campylobacteriales, there is only one bin.

- How strong is the evidence that these bins really have this pathway? Look at the `fam-found` and `minpath` columns.

the minpath is 0 and the fam-found is 1 out of 3 fams. the evidence for this bin actually having this pathway is weak.
